subject: Unscheduled maintenance: emergency fix for tokenizer alignment (short notice)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acme-corp.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji@bluebox.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 22:10:00 -0800
Subject: Unscheduled maintenance: emergency fix for tokenizer alignment (short notice)

Hi Marta / Kenji —

Quick note from the ops team: we observed a tokenizer alignment edge-case in the 2.1 runtime that, under a narrow set of prefixes, can cause KV cache blowups and elevated token costs (and in rare cases increased latency). The team reproduced the condition in staging and validated a small code-path patch that resolves the misalignment.

We need a short unscheduled maintenance window to apply the patch and bounce a subset of pods serving your region. Expected window: 2026-11-20 02:00–02:20 PST (20 minutes). We expect a 5–10 minute rolling disruption per model shard; most requests will failover to warm fallback instances for the duration.

What we need from you: please acknowledge that this window is acceptable or suggest an alternate 30-minute window within the next 6 hours. If we don't hear back by 01:15 PST we'll proceed with the earliest safe rollout and keep you closely updated.

Attachments: patch_diff_v1.patch (text diff), runbook_20261120.pdf (step checklist), rollback_playbook.txt (rollback steps).

Key mitigations during the window:
- Traffic will route to read-only fallbacks for 1–2 shards at a time
- Automatic retry & idempotency guards are enabled on the ingress layer
- We will run a quick verification suite (latency + token-count regression tests) post-rollout

I'm adding Jonas and Marissa from ops; they'll own the execution and postmortem.

Apologies for the short notice — we prioritized minimizing impact and avoiding a protracted degradation. I'll keep this thread as single source of truth.

— Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acme-corp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Kenji Sato <kenji@bluebox.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 23:02:14 -0800
Subject: Re: Unscheduled maintenance: emergency fix for tokenizer alignment (short notice)

Thanks Rafael —

We can accept the 02:00–02:20 PST window. Please confirm the rollback plan (what triggers an automatic rollback vs manual), and whether there are any API contract changes we should be aware of (we have a spike scheduled early morning). Also please call out what telemetry we should look at to confirm everything is normal on our side.

— Marta
Head of Platform Ops, Acme Corp

Update / ops checklist (short):

1) Pre-window (01:30–01:55 PST)
- Lock config: pin model versions for Acme-Prod routes
- Warm fallback nodes to 2x baseline
- Push patch to canary pool (one shard) and run quick smoke tests (token-count + latency)

2) Window (02:00–02:20 PST)
- Rolling restart per shard (max concurrency 2) — expected 5–10 min per shard
- Monitor: p99 latency, token-per-request median, KV cache eviction rate, error-rate (5xx)
- If error-rate > 2% sustained for 3 min OR token-per-request regresses > 15%, trigger rollback_playbook.txt (automatic threshold) and notify on #ops-emergency

3) Post-window (02:25–03:00 PST)
- Run verification suite (automated) and sanity checks, then a short manual smoke for Acme-specific prompt set
- Publish brief incident note to your team and schedule a 30-min after-action call (we propose 09:00 PST)

Telemetry for Acme you can watch:
- /metrics/token_count_per_call filtered by route acme-prod
- /traces/request_span sampled for 1% requests with tag acme-account-id
- Audit log: /logs/deployments/OPS-2319 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-2319)

Attachments included: runbook_20261120.pdf, rollback_playbook.txt (both on drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1runbook20261120).

I'll be the exec lead for the rollout. Rafael will send the external updates post-completion.

— Jonas
Principal Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@acme-corp.com>, Kenji Sato <kenji@bluebox.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 03:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Unscheduled maintenance: emergency fix for tokenizer alignment (short notice) — completed

Marta / Kenji —

Patch applied and rollout completed at 03:32 PST. Summary:
- Total window: 02:00–03:32 PST (we extended to complete verification across all shards; no customer-facing errors beyond brief 502 spikes on 2 shards during restarts)
- Status: PASSED verification suite; p99 latency within 3% of baseline; token-per-request median improved by ~2% in the problematic prefix group
- Actions: patch_diff_v1.patch applied to production, metrics and logs archived under OPS-2319, postmortem scheduled (proposed 09:00 PST)

Known follow-ups:
- We'll share the postmortem with detailed root cause, timeline, and code diff within 24 hours
- If you see any anomalous behavior (latency spikes, higher token counts) please reply here and tag us in #ops-emergency; we will escalate immediately

Apologies again for the short notice and thank you for confirming the window.

— Rafael
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: runbook_20261120.pdf, rollback_playbook.txt
